astranl.do_not_use_when: the job is outside the Netherlands, or the user needs a binding decision of the municipality
astranl.example_intent: What is the building permit fee in Haarlem for a 60000 euro renovation, and may I put a skip on the street?
astranl.next_possible_action: coordination_open_case or the human door https://astranl.com/en/do/ to find an executor for the job
astranl.proof_level: municipal regulation text on overheid.nl at the read date, checked by number match; not a municipal decision
astranl.returns: leges status and fee with regulation, article, source URL, read date and verification; container rule class, fee and precario with legal basis and source; links to the public pages
astranl.use_when: a user plans a renovation, extension or building job in the Netherlands and needs the permit fee or the skip-on-the-street rule of a municipality, with a source

annotations.title: Dutch municipal permit fee and skip rule for a building job

description: Dutch municipal rules for a renovation or building job, with ONE read-only call. Give a municipality, optionally the planned bouwkosten excluding VAT. Returns the 2026 omgevingsvergunning fee, leges, for the technical building activity as the municipality's own regulation sets it, and whether a skip or container on the public road needs a permit, a notification or nothing, with the permit fee and precario where confirmed. Every answer names the regulation, article and source URL, the read date and how it was verified. Coverage: all 342 municipalities for leges, 296 for containers. Limits: the municipality decides; spatial or other permit parts are not added; a fee is withheld when the tariff is not verified. Free, no auth, no side effects.

bouwkosten_eur.description: planned construction cost excluding VAT in euro; default 50000

municipality.description: Dutch municipality name or CBS code, e.g. Zaanstad or GM0479
